title: Analysing element 115 with Barry at S4

tellings.quote: It wasn't discovered. It's something Barry and I were working on.

plain: Bob Lazar, a physicist who says he worked in 1988 and 1989 at S4, a hidden site in the Nevada desert where he says captured alien craft were studied, says he and a colleague named Barry analysed element 115, a superheavy element he says fuelled the craft. He tells Michels he took part himself and insists "It wasn't discovered. It's something Barry and I were working on."
